in_hebrew.name: מדל

in_latin.name: Madelina
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the Latin word 'magnus' (great) and the suffix 'ella' (little), meaning 'little great one' or 'little tower'. This name is also derived from the Latin word 'madella' (tower), meaning 'little tower'.
